summary: First-pass full backend + frontend E2E test of AegisGraph. All 20 pytest cases pass (auth, roles, neo4j graceful fallback, 6-step query pipeline, LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH risk, vague HIGH summary without leaked names or SSNs, legal-role downgrade, history+search+CSV export, risk-trend, role update). Playwright E2E covers login page, dashboard query submission, response-card, history search filter, and profile risk-trend chart – all pass.

issues: Recharts warns 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' briefly during the empty-state → data transition. Cosmetic; the chart renders correctly once data arrives.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: get_current_user is duplicated as a dependency in every protected route (session_token cookie + auth header parsing). Extract into a FastAPI Depends() dependency for DRY.
server.py: deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') should be replaced with FastAPI lifespan context manager (FastAPI >=0.109).

Profile.jsx: risk-trend chart briefly rendering with hidden container triggers recharts width/height warning during transition; consider gating the ResponsiveContainer on `data !== null` rather than `series.length > 0` to avoid the flicker.
AuthContext.jsx: no automatic re-fetch on 401; if session expires the UI won't proactively bounce to /. Consider an axios response interceptor that logs the user out on 401.
history/export CSV writes columns even when the field is missing but does not URL-quote embedded newlines in the summary; Python csv module handles it, but confirm downstream Excel opens correctly.
llm.py: if the Claude call returns a partial JSON (no closing brace within re.DOTALL), the fallback silently kicks in. Good behaviour, but log the parse-failure for observability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (dashboard, history, profile, all data-testids present, submit flow works)

test_credentials: Uses pre-seeded MongoDB sessions from /app/memory/test_credentials.md: tok_ext_qa (external) and tok_legal_qa (legal). Both confirmed valid.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data required; tests use existing pre-seeded QA users and create ephemeral queries against their history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py – run with `pytest tests/backend_test.py -n 0` (xdist parallel splits classes across workers and TestHistory runs before TestQueryPipeline unless -n 0 is used; a class-scoped autouse fixture pre-seeds history so this is not blocking). Frontend Playwright cookies must be set with domain=aegis-graph.preview.emergentagent.com, secure=True, sameSite='None', httpOnly=True. All key testids: google-signin-btn, dashboard, query-input, send-query-button, response-card, graph-container, analysis-panel, history-page, history-search-input, export-csv-btn, history-item-{i}, profile-page, role-panel, role-select-trigger, risk-trend-chart, stat-{queries|avg.-score|low|medium|high}.
rca of the issue: N/A – no critical bugs found. Initial profile screenshot showing queries=0 was a race condition (screenshot captured before axios promise resolved); re-test with networkidle wait confirmed the chart renders 6 queries and correct LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH distribution.
